assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Restoring 'node = _launching._node_from_pointer(pointer)' in place of the guarded rebuild at reckon/crew/admission/reviews.py:166 raises TypeError out of queue_dispatch, reddening test_a_dispatch_after_a_put_back_updates_that_one_pointer and test_a_queued_node_is_redispatched_in_place_with_no_scope_conflict; logs/base-goal.log lines 253-254 show exactly those two ids red with the TypeError.

Reading the dispatch answer from result.output, the interleaved stream, instead of result.stdout makes _payload raise JSONDecodeError when the launch this case triggers prints its own line first; the pre-fix arm shows that fault at logs/base-goal.log line 255 as 'JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1' for test_a_different_node_over_a_queued_path_launches_the_older_request.

Fencing result.json instead of result.png makes the second node share the claim rather than collide, so the case stops refusing; it reddened at 8fdf39585f with 'AssertionError: reckon: created run r-...' at logs/base-goal.log line 256, and .png is exclusive under BINARY_SUFFIXES at reckon/crew/runs.py:1844.

The refusal is asserted against independent literals, exit_code 7 and the error string scope-conflict, and against the live pointer set read back from the store, so none of these compares a value with the input the test handed in.

assertions_added_note: three added or moved assertions reviewed; every one names a code change that reddens it, and none compares a value against the input the test itself passed in.

findings.text: _payload duplicates tests/test_dispatch_names_its_backend.py:159, the shared reader this file already imported, instead of extending it. The owner still reads the interleaved result.output at line 161, so the Click 8.2 fault the new helper corrects is left in place for the twenty test modules that delegate to it.

after_suite records a command whose PYTHONPATH and interpreter both name '/home/ITER/mcintos/Code/.reckon-worktrees/reckon-c8f839407e49/8e41a6d3-d0e0-4927-afd1-771942ebfe6a/qwnw-red-file-a-node-is-once-placeholder, a path that never existed, while logs/suite-after.log line 5 records the real worktree path; the receipt the promotion re-runs therefore cannot be reproduced as written.

the done_when requires the passing run 'as a job on all_debug with SLURM_JOB_ID unset'; the head arms ran pytest in the worktree as an ordinary command, and neither gate-head.log nor suite-after.log records a job id, a partition or a submission, so the all_debug clause is unrecorded rather than contradicted.

the header line reads '# module: 1' in both gate-head.log and suite-after.log, so 'the absolute path of the module under test as imported' is in fact an integer and a reader checking which reckon/crew/admission/reviews.py the run imported gets nothing; the base arm at logs/base-goal.log line 4 does carry the path.
